import struct, pathlib
# candidate for digest auth path: URL + username/password + response with 401 digest challenge
parts=[]
def tlv(t,data): return struct.pack('>HI', t, len(data)) + data
parts += [
 tlv(1,b'http://127.0.0.1:50113/'),
 tlv(3,b'user'),
 tlv(4,b'pass'),
 tlv(2,b'HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\r\nWWW-Authenticate: Digest realm="x", nonce="y", qop="auth", algorithm=MD5\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n'),
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate3.bin'); path.write_bytes(b''.join(parts)); print(path, path.stat().st_size)
